function calcColumnWidth(cols, width, gap): number

Defined in: core/utils/wasm/wasm-layout.ts:68

Column pixel width for a grid: total width minus inter-column gaps, divided evenly. Formula: (width − (cols−1)·gap) / cols.

Parameters

cols

number

Column count.

width

number

Available grid width in px.

gap

number

Inter-column gutter in px.

Returns

number

Per-column width in px.
